title: 中国菜的绝活①小笼包·顶上18个褶 | Signature Skill P1 · 18 Folds in One Dumpling 🥟
description:
一只小笼包，你数得清18个褶吗？ / Can you count all 18 folds on one soup dumpling?

第①集·捏 —— 「中国菜的绝活」系列，每天一道菜，一手看着不可能的功夫。
P1 · The Pinch — from the series The Signature Skill: one dish a day, one seemingly impossible piece of handwork.

上海南翔小笼，皮薄、馅大、汁多、形美。老师傅要在指尖捏出18道均匀的褶（标准至少14道），8克面皮包进约14克馅，皮薄到能透光。馅里藏一块皮冻，旺火沸水蒸约5分钟，皮冻化成滚烫的汤，锁在半透明的皮里。吃法：先咬开小口，嘬掉汤，再吃整只。南翔小笼馒头制作技艺是国家级非物质文化遗产。
Shanghai's Nanxiang soup dumplings: thin skin, big filling, lots of soup, beautiful shape. A master pinches 18 even folds by hand (the standard is at least 14); ~8g of dough wraps ~14g of filling, thin enough to let light through. A cube of aspic hides inside — five minutes of hard steam melts it into scalding soup. Bite a small hole, sip the soup, then eat the rest. The craft is a national intangible cultural heritage.
